<b>Delver's Drill</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Red|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. Using it causes Hornet to spin rapidly, dive and attack directly below her, hitting multiple times.

== Usefulness ==
* Delver's Drill has the potential to deal a high amount of damage in a single use, but is harder to land hits with than other {{CrestSlot|Red|s}}. In [[Act 3]], where [[Snare Setter]] is not available, it does the highest damage per use of any {{CrestSlot|Red|1}}, and can potentially deal more damage across all charges than any other.
* [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] prevents [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] from attacking upwards or moving upwards while drilling into them. However, enemies may attack or move upwards immediately afterwards without Hornet having a chance to move out of the way, making it safer to avoid using Delver's Drill on enemies that can do so.
* Hornet can cancel out of the drill dive by releasing the input that activates it. While the input is held, Hornet dives until she hits something, takes damage, or goes through a room transition.
** A charge is only consumed if the drill makes contact with an enemy, spikes, or a solid surface. Getting damaged out of the animation or falling into water does not consume a charge.
** While drilling an enemy, releasing the input will also allow Hornet to leave the drilling animation early. This reduces the total potential damage of the charge but can be used to evade incoming attacks.
* Delver's Drill can be useful while using crests with diagonal [[Needle]] bounces such as [[Hunter Crest]] and [[Beast Crest]], as Hornet cannot otherwise attack directly downwards while using them.
** Using the Delver's Drill on objects like the red flowers in [[Hunter's March]] and the void spheres in [[The Abyss (Silksong)|the Abyss]] will allow Hornet to bounce off them like a [[Needle#Needle-bouncing|Needle bounce]]. Doing this will not consume a charge of the drill. This makes it helpful for those who want vertical mobility in their kit without having to swap their [[Crests]]. 

{{clear|left}}

Found on a table in the southwestern [[Underworks]].
